title: Critique: consciousness needs time, and fundamental physics may lack it

statements.text: Many approaches to quantum gravity treat neither space nor time as fundamental. If conscious experience is essentially temporal, it cannot exist at a fundamental level that has no time, and for a photon, for which no time passes, it is unclear what experience could be.

sources.quote: There is a certain plausibility to the thesis that conscious experience is essentially temporal, which would seem to imply that consciousness cannot exist at the fundamental level of reality if time does not exist at the fundamental reality.
